xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3921: Route conversations and pan handoff through the terminal backend (Herdr) with role tokens; PTY supervisor off on Herdr

plan.title: Route conversations and pan handoff through the terminal backend (Herdr) with role tokens; PTY supervisor off on Herdr
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5-1

metadata.sizeJustification: 25 files, at the limit. The subsystem count reads 7 only because the two documentation files (docs/TERMINAL-BACKENDS.md, docs/THE-CUT.md) sit directly under docs/ and the first-two-segments rule counts each as its own subsystem; the real subsystems are six (packages/contracts, src/lib, src/dashboard, src/cli, sync-sources/skills, docs). The separable slice (runtimes/muse.ts, runtimes/kimi-code.ts) was already split into sibling PAN-3936. What remains is one behavior: a conversation pane on Herdr must be launched, kept alive, delivered to, waited on, and ended by the same backend — landing the launch without the liveness door mass-ends every conversation, so these items cannot ship as separate issues.

narratives.Problem: Conversations, pan handoff, and pan flywheel start still create their pane with tmux createSession (conversation-runtime.ts:808) and wrap the harness in the PTY supervisor (:705). On a Herdr host the pane never reaches Herdr, so a handoff cannot render as the issue's Review row (PAN-3917 FR-5); if the pane were redirected to Herdr today, the supervisor wrapper would hide the harness from Herdr's foreground-process detector and startAgent would close the pane after 60s (the pan start PAN-3705 failure). Every conversation liveness read (reads, list, delivery gate, fork seams, respawn wait, lifecycle poller, flywheel kickoff) is tmux-only, so a Herdr-hosted conversation would read as dead everywhere and the poller would end it 30s after creation.
narratives.Proposal: Launch conversations through the existing launch door (launchAgentPane) with the live agent name conv-<name> and pane tokens { issue?, role, harness, model }; add a `conversation` role to the contracts; decide the PTY supervisor by backend (tmux-only); persist a conversation's pane role in ~/.overdeck/conversations/<conv>/pane-role; add `pan handoff --role` (default conversation; review makes the handoff the Review row) and default `--issue` cwd to the issue workspace when no --cwd is given; add one backend-aware conversation liveness door (conversation-liveness.ts) and route every conversation liveness read through it, with Herdr `indeterminate` reading as alive; make pollConversations read listHerdrAgents on a Herdr host with a 90s grace; wait for readiness with herdr agent.wait for harnesses whose tmux readiness is a pane scrape; deliver the flywheel kickoff through deliverAgentMessage. Delivery and the terminal WebSocket already resolve Herdr agents by name, so they need no change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to src/lib/runtimes/muse.ts or src/lib/runtimes/kimi-code.ts (sibling PAN-3936).
- No per-harness fallback to tmux on a Herdr host; an acp conversation fails Herdr detection exactly as work agents do today.
- No DB migration for the pane role; it is a state-dir file.
- conversation-pane-choice.ts (numbered-menu capture) and captureCorpseDiagnostics stay tmux-only.
- No frontend changes beyond the contracts literal; no new row type for `conversation` panes.
- isAliveSync stays tmux-only (PAN-3917 known gap).
- The FR-17 prompt guard is not widened: a `conversation` role with an issue token is not the issue's work pane.
- No change to how deliverAgentMessage or the terminal WebSocket resolve a Herdr agent by name.

autoDecisions.summary: Add a `conversation` value to AgentRole / BackendPane.role instead of reusing `work` for conversation panes.
autoDecisions.rationale: PaneTokens.role is a required closed literal. Stamping `work` on an issue-scoped conversation would render a second Work row and let it prompt the issue's workers under the FR-17 guard; `conversation` keeps the guard's operator/work distinction intact.

autoDecisions.summary: Persist the pane role in ~/.overdeck/conversations/<conv>/pane-role rather than a conversations-table column.
autoDecisions.rationale: The conversations table sits behind two migration systems; a state-dir file is created by the same code that writes launcher.sh, survives respawn/resume/restart-all/fork recovery, and needs no migration.

autoDecisions.summary: `pan handoff --issue <id>` defaults the successor cwd to workspaces/feature-<id> when it exists and no --cwd was given.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-3917 FR-5 says the handoff pane is placed in the issue workspace; the workspace is a git worktree so the existing isInsideGitWorkTree check passes, and an explicit --cwd still wins.

autoDecisions.summary: Split the muse.ts / kimi-code.ts runtime-adapter fix into sibling issue PAN-3936.
autoDecisions.rationale: Their only live callers are specialist rotation and crash respawn, the change depends on nothing in this plan, and keeping them here pushes the plan past the finalize surface gate (25 files / 6 subsystems).

autoDecisions.summary: No per-harness tmux fallback when Herdr cannot detect a harness.
autoDecisions.rationale: Parity with work agents, which already launch every harness through launchAgentPane without fallback; a mixed placement would make the inventory read the tmux-hosted pane as dead.

autoDecisions.summary: On a Herdr host, readiness for ohmypi/muse/kimi-code/codex-tui conversations uses herdr agent.wait(['idle','blocked']) instead of tmux pane scrapes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Herdr's agent states are the oracle for any detected kind; waitForPiTuiReady and friends read tmux panes that do not exist on Herdr.

autoDecisions.summary: Herdr `indeterminate` (socket did not answer) reads as alive in the conversation liveness door.
autoDecisions.rationale: Same rule isAliveOnHerdr applies to agents: a Herdr outage must never end every conversation at once.
